name: formal-verification
description: Establish and audit formal guarantees for MDK's protocol safety, convergence, crash recovery, and eventual progress. Use when asked to prove an invariant, model-check a race or crash/restart sequence, find gaps in formal coverage, check whether a model still matches changed Rust, or choose a verification tool or language. Extend MDK's Tamarin, TLA+/TLC, and Stateright work where suitable; evaluate current alternatives when they can establish a missing guarantee. Connect each claim to production code, state its bounds and assumptions, and demonstrate that its check detects a relevant defect. Ordinary test authoring and test-suite cleanup belong to test-audit.
